entries.description: Operator set pathAwareCritique: advisory.

Registered S1 via start_session (claude/anthropic/claude-opus-5/high); read the preload (constitution, project-guidance, lessons-learned, CLAUDE.md); confirmed the three DABBLER_* provider keys are present; no decision-review-queue entries.

Read spec.md and cached the Session Set Configuration block: tier=full, requiresUAT=true (S4 walks it), requiresE2E=false, uatStyle=ad-hoc, uatScope=per-set, pathAwareCritique=advisory (set-terminal, S4). Cached S1's plan: Creates=enumeration module + lockfile + tests; Touches=router-config.yaml metadata only; progress keys enumerationBuilt/lockfileWritten/driftGateFailsLoudOnGpt56/servedModelRecorded.
Prerequisites: spec declares none (Set 109 is the head of its chain; Set 110 declares 109 as ITS prerequisite). Confirmed 109 and 110 are the only non-complete sets, and 110 is not-started.
Step 3.5: routed analysis (task_type=analysis, exclude_providers=[anthropic]) -> gemini-pro/gemini-2.5-pro, $0.0153, truncation-clean. Saved raw as s1-ai-assignment-analysis.json.

Probed all three enumeration endpoints live: OpenAI GET /v1/models (124 ids, 'gpt-5.6' ABSENT while gpt-5.6-luna/-sol/-terra are present -> the gate's live specimen confirmed); Anthropic GET /v1/models (11 ids, cursor-paginated via has_more/last_id); Google GET /v1beta/models (58 ids, 'models/' name prefix, nextPageToken). Second finding: registry entry gemini-3-pro (identity-only) is ALSO absent -- Google lists only gemini-3-pro-preview. Also probed the served-model field on completion calls: Anthropic data['model']='claude-sonnet-4-6' (exact echo), Google data['modelVersion']='gemini-2.5-pro' (bare id), OpenAI data['model'] for requested 'gpt-5.4-mini' = 'gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17' (DATED SNAPSHOT -- so OpenAI mismatches on every call, not only on the gpt-5.6 alias).

Routed the six-question enumeration/gate design (task_type=architecture, exclude_providers=[anthropic]) -> gemini-pro/gemini-2.5-pro (opus excluded by the no-skip anthropic exclusion), $0.0798 incl. auto-verification, truncation-clean. Saved raw as s1-enumeration-design.json. Adopted JSON lockfile, --refresh/--check split, check-never-probes, missing-lock fatal, served_model_id on APIResult, no runtime action on mismatch. Departed on five points (recorded in ai-assignment.md).

Wrote ai_router/model_inventory.py: per-provider list-endpoint resolution derived from the existing providers.<name>.base_url (no new config keys), three pure page parsers that fail loud on a reshaped envelope, cursor/pageToken pagination with a repeated-cursor loop guard, injectable httpx.Client, and probe_provider() that refuses an empty model list. Ran --refresh: anthropic 11, google 58, openai 124 ids -> ai_router/model-inventory.lock (per-provider probed_at).

Shipped the drift gate. --check reads two local files and never probes. Routable miss = exit 1 fail-loud naming the entry; identity-only miss = reported note, exit 0 (--strict promotes it); provider never enumerated = exit 2 fatal, deliberately NOT drift; per-provider staleness warns at 30 days (matches metadata.review_frequency_days). ENDS-WITH HALF 1 PROVEN: 'python -m ai_router.model_inventory --check' exits 1 naming gpt-5-6 / model_id='gpt-5.6'. Gate deliberately UNWIRED from drift_guard.py (its test asserts the real repo passes; S4 fixes the registry, then it can be wired).

Recorded the served model. APIResult gains served_model_id (None when unreported) via one shared defensive extractor; anthropic data['model'], google data['modelVersion'], openai data['model']. metrics.record_call gains requested_model_id + served_model_id (additive, null on all 1196 historical rows); all six record_call sites pass them, including both copilot-cli sites via the transport's already-parsed echoed_model (L-069-1 sibling parity). ENDS-WITH HALF 2 PROVEN live: three routed calls recorded requested vs served, and gpt-5.4-mini came back served as gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17.

Added ai_router/tests/test_model_inventory.py (46 tests), test_served_model_recording.py (18 tests), and model_inventory_fixtures.py (verbatim subsets of the 2026-08-04 live captures). All 64 pass; none opens a socket (httpx.MockTransport throughout, plus an explicit test that --check cannot construct an HTTP client).

Touched router-config.yaml (metadata only, no price edits, per the spec): registry-header block documenting the --refresh/--check CLI and why the gate is unwired; a KNOWN DRIFT note on gpt-5-6 naming the sol resolution and the 2x understatement and telling S4 not to point-fix the id without the price work; a note on gemini-3-pro explaining the identity-only NOTE line. Added the Set 109 S1 entries to ai_router/CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased].

Re-read the new module before verification and fixed three real defects: is_enabled defaulted to False where every other reader in the package defaults it True (would demote a routable entry omitting the flag to a note); --strict printed an OK summary while exiting 1; a snapshot missing probed_at could never be judged stale and would pass forever (now fatal). Each has a regression test.

Full pass: pytest -m 'not e2e' -> 3207 passed, 6 skipped, 8 deselected, 0 failed (21m46s). drift_guard OK, tutorial_gate OK, guidance_report --check OK (10,895/12,000 tokens). No TypeScript/extension/webview/state-writer/fixture surface touched, so Layers 2-3 do not arm (requiresE2E false). Confirming full re-run started after the three post-run fixes.

Phased discovery round 1: verifier gpt-5-6 (openai; anthropic excluded via the orchestrator's registry-resolved provider), 2/2 fan-out on identical bundles, $0.4443. Verdict ISSUES_FOUND, blocking: 5 findings = 3 distinct issues (the fan-out independently duplicated two). A: verifier-only entries can bypass the gate (Major). B: requested-vs-served mismatch recorded but never FLAGGED, against the spec's literal 'flag any mismatch' (Major, found by both calls). C: the Google API key is passed as a URL query param, so an httpx HTTPStatusError renders it into InventoryError and the CLI prints it to stderr (Major, security, found by both calls).

Checked finding A's premise before remediating. Its stated mechanism is FALSE: verification.py's candidate loop applies rule 2 (is_enabled) BEFORE rule 3 (is_enabled_as_verifier), so an is_enabled:false + is_enabled_as_verifier:true entry can never be selected as a verifier, and the proposed fix would have manufactured a false hard-failure. But checking it found a REAL and different bypass: models.pick_model returns a task_type_overrides pin WITHOUT the _survives() check whenever exclude_providers is empty. Proved empirically on a synthetic config: a pinned is_enabled:false model is returned with no exclusion, and only the exclusion path filters it. So 'is_enabled alone' is NOT the right routability test, and the finding's substance stands via a mechanism the verifier did not name.

Checked finding A's premise before remediating. Its stated mechanism is FALSE: verification.py applies rule 2 (is_enabled) BEFORE rule 3 (is_enabled_as_verifier), so that config can never be selected as a verifier and the proposed fix would have manufactured a false hard-failure. But checking it found a REAL, different bypass: models.pick_model returns a task_type_overrides pin WITHOUT the _survives() check when exclude_providers is empty -- proved empirically on a synthetic config. So routability is is_enabled OR named in task_type_overrides/tier_assignments.
Supplementary completeness-critic pass (round 2, same evidence, pre-remediation) -> VERIFIED, 0 findings, $0.1785. Nothing added to the harvest; the discovery blockers stand until remediated.

Fixed all three distinct blockers in one pass; sidecar s1-remediation-round-1.md. (A) routability now = is_enabled OR pinned in task_type_overrides/tier_assignments, with the pick_model bypass itself recorded as a NAMED DEFERRAL for S2 (changing model selection is outside S1's Touches). (B) served_model_mismatch added as a TRI-STATE column (null when either id is absent, not false) plus served_model_mismatches()/print_served_model_mismatches() wired into print_metrics_report -- a column nothing reports is not a flag. (C) SECURITY: Google key moved from the query string to the x-goog-api-key header in BOTH model_inventory.fetch_google and the pre-existing sibling providers._call_google (L-069-1), plus redact_secret() over every httpx error and 'raise from None' so a chained traceback cannot leak it. 85 tests pass (19 added). Proved live: --refresh re-probed google over header auth (58 ids) and a live gemini-flash query returned normally.

Remediation-review (round 3) on the fix delta against the round-1 baseline tree: VERIFIED, 0 blocking, 0 minor, 3 fix-accepted / 0 rejected / 0 accepted-with-modification, $0.0713. The verifier independently identified findings 4 and 5 as duplicates of 3 and 2. Loop closed non-blocking in 3 rounds; total verification cost $0.6941.

Post-remediation full pass: pytest -m 'not e2e' -> 3228 passed, 6 skipped, 8 deselected, 0 failed (23m36s), up from the 3143-test pre-session baseline (+85 new). drift_guard OK, tutorial_gate OK, guidance_report --check OK (10,895/12,000).

Authored disposition.json: status completed, verification_method api, verification_verdict VERIFIED, next_orchestrator claude-code/anthropic/claude-opus-5/high (continue-current-trajectory), lessons_cited L-069-1 / L-064-9 / L-095-1. Recorded the models.pick_model is_enabled bypass as a NAMED DEFERRAL to S2 rather than a silent residual.
